id, sn, phone_type, imei1, imei2, model, activated, activate_date, coverage, image_path, sys_time, create_time, create_by, nick_name, update_time, update_by
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(sys_time, ''), DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d'))) = STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS activatedDevices, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activated = 0 OR activated IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(sys_time, ''), DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d'))) = STR_TO_DATE(#{previousDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS yesterdayOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(sys_time, ''), DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')), '%Y-%m') = #{currentMonth} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS currentMonthOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(sys_time, ''), DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')), '%Y-%m') = #{previousMonth} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS previousMonthOrders FROM phone_active_info

SELECT COUNT(*) AS myTotalOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(sys_time, ''), DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d'))) = STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS myTodayOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS myActivatedDevices, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN activated = 0 OR activated IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS myPendingOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(sys_time, ''), DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d'))) = STR_TO_DATE(#{previousDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS myYesterdayOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(sys_time, ''), DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d'))) BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{recentSevenDaysStart}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS myRecentSevenDaysOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(COALESCE(NULLIF(sys_time, ''), DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d'))) BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{previousSevenDaysStart}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{previousSevenDaysEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS myPreviousSevenDaysOrders FROM phone_active_info WHERE create_by = #{createBy}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(sys_time, ''), DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')), '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN activated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activatedCount FROM phone_active_info WHERE DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(sys_time, ''), DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')), '%Y-%m') >= #{startMonth} AND DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(sys_time, ''), DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')), '%Y-%m') <= #{endMonth} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(sys_time, ''), DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')), '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
SELECT CASE WHEN model IS NULL OR TRIM(model) = '' THEN '未知型号' ELSE model END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM phone_active_info GROUP BY name ORDER BY value DESC, name ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN coverage IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(coverage) != '' AND STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(coverage, 1, 10), '%Y-%m-%d') > DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS inWarrantyCount, COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN coverage IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(coverage) != '' AND STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(coverage, 1, 10), '%Y-%m-%d') >= STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(coverage, 1, 10), '%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS nearExpiryCount, COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN coverage IS NULL OR TRIM(coverage) = '' OR STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(coverage, 1, 10), '%Y-%m-%d') IS NULL OR STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING(coverage, 1, 10), '%Y-%m-%d') < STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS expiredCount FROM phone_active_info
